Kit summary

Holy ArrowBasic
Deals 360% ATK DMG to a single enemy. If the target has an attribute debuff, additionally increases 25% DMG; if the target is under Control status, additionally increases 50% DMG instead.
Holy BreathActiveExclusive Lv.1
Grants self [DMG Immunity] and [Control Immunity] for 1 turn, then pursues and attacks 4 enemy targets under Control status 1 time.
Light-forged Bow Lv.1Extends the duration of [DMG Immunity] and [Control Immunity] granted by Holy Breath to 2 turns. Olga acts 1 extra turn after casting Holy Breath.
Light-forged ForcePassive
Olga takes 25% less Direct DMG when she is attacked by heroes with countered Mark. Olga has a 100% chance to pursue and attack 1 time after an ally casts skills that deal DMG proactively.
Light-forged ArrowActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Deals 4 stages of 180% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. The first 3 stages of attack reduce the target’s Turn Meter by 15% each, and the 4th stage inflicts [Silence] for 1 turn.
Light-forged Bow Lv.2Olga deals 35% more Direct DMG to The Forgotten, Eternal Sect, and Doom Legion enemies and takes 25% less Direct DMG from them; Olga pursues and attacks the targets 1 time after casting Light-forged Arrow.
Light-forged Bow Lv.3Light-forged Arrow: The first 3 stage reduces Turn Meter by 25% each. If the target’s Turn Meter is 0 when the 4th stage deals DMG, the inflicted [Silence] inflicted cannot be removed for 2 turns.
